title: SE & ProServices Integration Pulse — 2025-03-18
content:
Attendees: Eleanor Park (owner), Aisha Kapoor, Ben Morales, Chen Li, Daniel Rivers + ad-hoc: Priya (SRE), Marco (Sales)

Purpose: weekly triage + sync on active customer integrations (priority, blockers, next milestones). Keep lightweight — capture decisions and concrete owners.

Quick summary:
- 6 active integrations discussed this week. 2 are on-track for Q2 pilot, 3 need engineering/infra support to unblock, 1 is stalled pending customer data export.
- Main cross-cutting issues: network egress policies for private deployments, a transient regression in model kv-cache behavior (serving-runtime team tracking), and mismatched expectations on SLAs for Dedicated bursts.

Per-customer notes:

1) BrightCart (retail search personalization) — Owner: Aisha
- Status: Pilot environment provisioned; model selection complete (redwood/gpt-large-quantized-v1).
- Completed: test dataset upload, basic inference smoke tests (latency ~85ms p50 on dedicated pool).
- Blockers: customer needs VPC peering for low-latency access; internal ticket JIRA-8421 created for networking; SRE (Priya) to own peering runbook and timeline.
- Risks: if peering slips >2 weeks, BrightCart wants temporary VPN tunnel (sales flagged potential churn).
- Next actions: Priya to scope peering steps and ETA by 2025-03-21; Aisha to send customer update 2025-03-20.

2) AtlasDocs (SaaS documentation assistant) — Owner: Ben
- Status: Integration in canary stage on Dedicated; embeddings pipeline finalized.
- Completed: ingestion pipeline to vector DB via Redwood embeddings; canary serving with fallback model configured.
- Blockers: occasional 502s when traffic exceeds batching threshold — likely autoscaler tuning + runtime bug. CHEN to reproduce; linked to JIRA-8597.
- Decision: temporarily lower burst threshold for canary and increase logging for calls failing with 502.
- Next actions: Chen to reproduce locally by 2025-03-19 and post findings; devops to apply temporary threshold change by 2025-03-20.

3) FinSecure (enterprise private deployment) — Owner: Daniel
- Status: Private deployment kickoff meeting held; compliance checklist in progress.
- Completed: contract and NDA signed; initial network diagram approved.
- Blockers: KMS/HSM integration — customer requires HSM-backed key wrapping (on-prem HSM). Security team needs to validate HSM adapter; security lead (Marco) coordinating.
- Notes: estimate 4 weeks for HSM validation + integrator scheduling.
- Next actions: Daniel to book KMS validation session w/security on 2025-03-21; Marco to share HSM adapter spec.

4) Learnly (edtech, high concurrency) — Owner: Chen
- Status: Load-testing phase; experiments with batching and kv-cache strategies ongoing.
- Completed: baseline throughput measured; cost/provisioning tradeoff doc drafted.
- Blockers: memory pressure on smaller GPU instance types when using long context lengths; potential need to recommend larger instance family or quantized model variant.
- Temporary mitigation: reduce max context for canary users to 4k tokens and enable prefix caching.
- Next actions: Chen to finalize recommendation doc by 2025-03-22 and schedule customer review.

5) VoyagerHealth (clinical summaries) — Owner: Eleanor
- Status: Stalled — customer data export delayed due to legal/compliance review.
- Completed: initial mapping of PHI redaction requirements.
- Blockers: legal needs sample data artifacts; customer timeline unclear.
- Decision: put onboarding into "waiting" state; maintain weekly check-ins.
- Next actions: Eleanor to follow up with customer legal on 2025-03-24.

6) Nimbus Analytics (adtech, batch embeddings) — Owner: Aisha (supporting)
- Status: large-scale batch embedding job scheduled this month.
- Completed: job plan and cost estimate accepted.
- Blockers: quota bump required for short window; platform-engineering to approve temporary capacity increase.
- Next actions: Aisha to confirm quota request ticket and expected completion date (target 2025-03-25).

Cross-team issues / notes:
- Serving-runtime: Chen reported intermittent kv-cache regression after recent kernel swap. Serving-runtime to prioritize a bisect with quantization test harness. Linked: GH:infra/pooled-gpus#438.
- Private deployments: common ask for clearer network runbooks and a VPC peering template. Action: Solutions to draft a "VPC peering + transit setup" short guide (owner: Eleanor, due 2025-03-28).
- Dedicated: Sales reported customer confusion about burst capacity billing; product to prepare a one-pager describing burst behavior and cost implications (owner: Marco, due 2025-03-24).

Action items (owner — due):
- Priya (SRE) — scope VPC peering steps + ETA for BrightCart — 2025-03-21
- Chen (serving-runtime) — reproduce 502s for AtlasDocs & post debug notes to JIRA-8597 — 2025-03-19
- Marco (security/product) — share HSM adapter spec with Daniel — 2025-03-21
- Eleanor — VPC peering guide draft for customers (short) — 2025-03-28
- Ben — confirm temporary autoscaler change applied to canary — 2025-03-20
- Aisha — confirm quota bump ticket for Nimbus batch job — 2025-03-18 (ETA update in thread)
- Daniel — schedule KMS validation session with security — 2025-03-21

Open questions / To follow up:
- Do we need a formal SLA addendum for Dedicated burst guarantees? (sales/customer ask) — Marco to scope with product.
- Should we expose a simplified VPC peering checklist in Console for Private deployments? (product/console)
- How to instrument kv-cache regressions to detect early in production? (observability + serving-runtime)

Notes to self / messy bits (working):
- Customer timezones are messy this week — schedule next sync as 9:00am PDT / 17:00 CET to include EU customers; propose recurring weekly cadence.
- Draft email templates for "onboarding paused" and "peering ETA" to speed comms.

Decisions made:
- Put VoyagerHealth onboarding on hold until legal clears sample data.
- Apply temporary autoscaler/burst threshold reduction for AtlasDocs canary.

Next meeting: 2025-03-25 09:00 PDT / 17:00 CET (weekly) — agenda: blocker's status updates, serving-runtime regression progress, Dedicated pricing one-pager review.

Attachments / references:
- Link to runbook draft (placeholder): CONFLUENCE:Customer-Integrations-Playbook
- Jira tickets referenced: JIRA-8421, JIRA-8597
- GH debug PR: GH:infra/pooled-gpus#438

End of notes.
